widgets.title: Community Publisher
widgets.description: Publish and translate articles directly from the community — moderators only

properties.name: communityBaseUrl
properties.label: Community Base URL
properties.description: Base URL of your community (e.g. https://community.yourcompany.com) — used for View links after publishing

properties.name: supportEmail
properties.label: Support Email
properties.description: Email shown in the AI translation disclaimer appended to translated articles

properties.name: defaultCategories
properties.label: Default Category IDs per Language
properties.description: JSON map of language code → category ID. E.g. {"fr":69,"es":42,"de":15}. Get IDs from community URLs like /knowledgebase-69. These are auto-selected in each language dropdown.
